components.name: Primary Project Action
components.description: Clear action for the current featured project.
components.html: Visit project
components.css: .ds-action-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:18px; min-height:46px; padding:11px 18px; border:1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius:5px; background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-accent-contrast); font:700 12px Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 150ms,border-color 150ms; } .ds-action-primary svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background:var(--color-accent-hover); border-color:var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.html: View resume
components.css: .ds-action-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px; min-height:46px; padding:11px 18px; border:1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius:5px; background:var(--color-control); color:var(--color-ink); font:700 12px Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 150ms,border-color 150ms; } .ds-action-secondary svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-action-secondary:hover { background:#1b283d; border-color:var(--color-accent); } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Home Contact Action
components.description: Square blue Contact action over the full-screen hero.
components.css: .ds-home-contact { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px; min-height:44px; min-width:132px; padding:9px 17px; border:1px solid #61b6ff; background:#61b6ff; color:#061222; font:700 11px Manrope,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 150ms,border-color 150ms; } .ds-home-contact svg { width:15px; height:15px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-home-contact:hover { background:#8acaff; border-color:#8acaff; } .ds-home-contact:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Current Route Link
components.description: Small centered route links with a blue active underline.
components.html: HomeProjectsContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:22px; } .ds-nav a { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:var(--color-ink-secondary); font:600 11px Manrope,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a::after { content:""; position:absolute; right:0; bottom:2px; left:0; height:2px; background:var(--color-accent); transform:scaleX(0); transition:transform 180ms; } .ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Project Slide Selector
components.description: A row of directly selectable markers for all featured projects.
components.css: .ds-pagination { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; } .ds-pagination button { display:flex; flex:1 1 12px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:12px; height:36px; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-pagination button span { width:100%; height:2px; background:#aab5c6a6; transition:height 180ms,background 180ms; } .ds-pagination button:hover span { background:#e5eefb; } .ds-pagination button[aria-pressed="true"] span { height:4px; background:var(--color-slide-active); box-shadow:0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-slide-active) 40%,transparent); } .ds-pagination button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Slideshow Control

components.html: <button class="ds-slide-control" type="button" aria-label="Next project"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/></svg></button>

narrative.overview:
Home follows the supplied reference composition: the active project image spans the viewport, a layered black and charcoal scrim gives it depth, and the introduction sits over it in a large serif display face. Cool gray text carries project context while blue marks the emphasized headline, primary actions, and active slide. Navigation stays compact at the top; a scroll cue and individually selectable project markers anchor the lower edge.

The rest of the portfolio keeps the same dark palette and tighter information rhythm. Home continues into the original sections, and the original nine dedicated routes retain their content and purpose. Manrope handles navigation, controls, metadata, and body copy. Georgia appears only in the Home hero display. The previous warm-paper direction is retired; the owner's current reference is the authority for this hero.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport, full-bleed project slideshow with a legibility scrim.
Large white serif headline with an italic blue emphasis.
Black, charcoal, cool gray, and controlled blue accents.
Compact supporting copy, project metadata, and clear actions.
Dense panels and preserved page structure below the hero.

rules.name: The Blue Cue Rule
rules.body: Reserve filled blue for primary actions and the active project cue. Keep secondary emphasis as text or an outline.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Keep Georgia for the Home hero headline. Use Manrope for the remaining interface and all supporting copy.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed, Tight-Content Rule
rules.body: Let genuine project imagery fill the hero, but keep the details and sections tightly grouped so a tall screen does not become a blank stage.

rules.name: The Legibility Scrim Rule
rules.body: Every project image in the hero receives the same layered dark overlay; do not rely on a particular screenshot being dark.

dos: Do keep the palette black, charcoal, gray, and blue across all routes.
Do use the reference's full-screen image, editorial headline, compact navigation, and lower slide indicators on Home.
Do preserve every project, all 14 direct slide selectors, and the original nine routes and page content.
Do keep dynamic project labels truthful, especially Figma designs and in-progress work.
Do respect reduced motion, keyboard focus, and touch input.
donts: Don't reintroduce the rejected warm-paper palette.
Don't let the hero scrim disappear on light project screenshots.
Don't make Home sections or original dedicated pages difficult to reach.
Don't claim a generic GitHub profile is a project repository or label designs as live sites.
Don't invent credentials, results, availability, or project content.
